altText._note: The live components give posters, card images and the MassField frame empty alt text on purpose, because the link text next to them carries the meaning. These rules are for images that carry meaning on their own.
principles: Describe what a buyer would notice: the material, the light, the setting. Never start with ‘Image of’.
Name the product category, not the client, unless the client has approved it in writing.
Mark generated imagery wherever it could pass for the real thing: start with ‘AI-generated visual:’. Anything that shows an unbuilt property starts with ‘Artist’s impression:’.
Pharma: describe the visual, never the effect. ‘Animation still: a molecule approaching a receptor’, not ‘medicine relieving pain’.
Behind-the-scenes images: describe the set and the work, never the person. No names, no descriptions of anyone on the crew.
Texture, grain and background loops are decorative: give them empty alt text.

hero.headline: Behind the camera. On purpose.
hero.body: You won’t find our faces on this site. You’ll find the work. Light Matter Reality is an AI-led creative studio in Mumbai, and it speaks as one studio, not as a collection of personal brands.

whyFaceless.headline: Why there are no faces here.
body: Most studios sell a personality. We’d rather you judged the work.
A face invites the wrong questions: who did what, who’s senior, whose taste you’re paying for. A studio answers the only one that matters: is the work good?
Hire LMR and you hire all of it: the cinematographer’s eye, the editor’s timing, the designer’s restraint, the strategist’s logic. One studio. One signature.

tenets.title: Taste can’t be prompted.
tenets.body: Anyone can generate an image. Knowing which one to keep, and why, is the job. That’s taste, and there’s no shortcut to it.

tenets.title: We did it the hard way first.
tenets.body: We learnt light on sets, rhythm in edit suites and persuasion in strategy rooms, long before AI. That’s how we know when a generated frame is lying.

tenets.title: AI is the accelerator. Never the author.
tenets.body: AI speeds up the pipeline: worlds, variations, versions. The story, the choices and the sign-off stay human.

tenets.title: Story before spectacle.
tenets.body: A beautiful frame with nothing to say is still nothing. We find the narrative first. Then we make it beautiful.

tenets.title: No copy-paste strategy.
tenets.body: Bridal gold and beachwear silver don’t live in the same world. Neither do a Thane 2BHK and a sea-facing flat in Worli. Every brand gets its own.

tenets.title: We study why people buy.
tenets.body: Before we make anything, we work out what your buyer wants, what they fear, and what they’ll tell their family. Then we make that.

tenets.title: Some things need a real set.
tenets.body: Gold, fabric, a finished space: some things have to be shot for real. We have the crew for that, and the judgment to know when.

tenets.title: The work does the talking.
tenets.body: No faces, no founder myth. If the work doesn’t convince you, nothing we say about ourselves should.

meta.description: Brand films, ad films, reels, product shoots and AI video from a Mumbai studio that lit real sets long before it rendered AI ones.
meta.ogTitle: Light: film and photography | Light Matter Reality
meta.ogDescription: Brand films, ad films, reels, product shoots and AI video. Some things need a real set. Some don’t. We know which.

hero.name: Light
hero.headline: Everything starts with how it’s lit.
hero.body: Brand films, ad films, reels, product shoots and AI video, made by people who learnt light on real sets. That’s why the generated ones hold up.

shootOrGenerate.headline: Some things need a real set. Some don’t. We know which.
shootOrGenerate.body: Gold has to catch real light. A sea view from a tower that isn’t built yet can be imagined. We decide shot by shot: real production where the product must be true, AI where it buys you speed, scale or a world you couldn’t build. Most projects use both.

items.title: Brand films
items.body: The film that tells people who you are, without a voice-over saying so. Concept, script, shoot, edit, grade and sound.

items.title: Ad films
items.body: Fifteen, thirty and sixty-second spots made for the platform they’ll run on, with cut-downs planned from day one.

items.title: Reels and short-form
items.body: A hook in the first second, pacing that holds, an ending worth sharing. Cut by editors who were cutting long before Reels.

items.title: Product shoots
items.body: Studio and on-location photography for things that have to look real: jewellery, fabric, packaging, finished spaces.

items.title: AI product photography
items.body: We shoot the product for real, then build the world around it. Collections go out faster, without a new set for every drop.

items.title: AI video
items.body: Generated worlds, impossible camera moves and scenes you couldn’t afford to build, directed like a real production.

directed.headline: Directed, not generated.
directed.body: Every AI frame goes past the same eyes that would judge a real one: a director’s, a cinematographer’s, an editor’s. If it wouldn’t survive a real edit, it doesn’t ship.

items.body: Jewellery shoots lit for metal and stone, festive ad films, AI lookbooks.
Pre-launch teasers, launch films, walkthroughs and handover films.
Architectural and interior photography, project films.
Mechanism explainers, training videos, and ad films where advertising is permitted.

items.q: Is everything you make AI?
items.a: No. We shoot for real when the product has to be true, and use AI where it adds speed, scale or worlds we couldn’t build. Most projects use both.

items.q: Do you shoot on location in Mumbai?
items.a: Yes. We’re based in Mumbai and shoot across Mumbai, Thane and Navi Mumbai. Further afield on request. [VERIFY: travel policy]

items.q: Will AI visuals look fake?
items.a: Not if they’re directed properly. Every generated frame is judged against the standard of a real shoot. If it looks fake to us, it never reaches you.

items.q: How long does a brand film take?
items.a: It depends on the scope. As a guide, [TURNAROUND: brand film, brief to delivery]. Ad film sets and reels move faster.

items.q: Who owns the footage?
items.a: Usage rights are set out in every contract before work begins. [VERIFY: standard ownership and usage terms]

meta.ogTitle: Matter: design and brand | Light Matter Reality
meta.ogDescription: Strategy, story, identity and packaging. Pretty is easy now. Meaning isn’t.

hero.name: Matter
hero.headline: What your brand is made of.
hero.body: Strategy, story, identity, packaging and the social systems that carry them. Design that knows why people buy, not just what looks good this week.

intro.headline: Pretty is easy now. Meaning isn’t.
intro.body: AI can generate a hundred logos before lunch. None of them will know your buyer, your category, or why people choose you over the shop next door. We start there.

items.title: Brand strategy
items.body: Positioning, audience, and the one thing you should be known for. Written down, argued for, agreed.

items.title: Storytelling and narrative
items.body: The story your brand tells in every film, post and pitch. We write it once, properly, and everything else follows it.

items.title: Identity
items.body: Logo, type, colour and the rules that hold them together. Built to work on a hoarding and on a WhatsApp status.

items.title: Packaging
items.body: Boxes, pouches and labels that feel like the product inside, from jewellery boxes to retail cartons.

items.title: Social systems
items.body: Templates, grids and rules, so your feed looks like one brand whoever posts it.

items.title: Carousels and graphics
items.body: Carousels people read to the last slide, and graphics that don’t look like everyone else’s.

psychology.headline: Design that knows why people buy.
psychology.body: People don’t decide on beauty alone. They decide on trust, status, the fear of a bad choice, and what their family will say. We design for those, on purpose.

items.body: Identities for jewellers and labels, packaging, festive campaign systems.
Project identities, launch campaign systems, broker and channel-partner kits.
Practice branding, portfolio design, project carousels.
Brand systems and social graphics, sober enough for medical review.

items.q: Do you do strategy, or just design?
items.a: Both. Strategy comes first and design makes it visible. You can hire us for either, but they work best together.

items.q: Can you refresh our brand without losing what people know?
items.a: Yes. Most established brands need a sharper version of themselves, not a new one. We keep what’s been earned and fix what’s dated.

items.q: Do you make the content, or just the templates?
items.a: Both. We build the system, and on a Studio Retainer we run it for you.

items.q: How long does an identity project take?
items.a: As a guide, [TURNAROUND: identity project, brief to delivery].

cta.headline: Make it matter.
cta.body: Tell us what your brand should stand for. We’ll help you prove it.

hero.name: Reality
hero.headline: Where your brand becomes a place.
hero.body: Websites, landing pages, scroll-animated and 3D sites, walkthroughs, custom apps and the CRM workflows behind them. The part of the story people can step into, and the part that sells.

intro.headline: Your website is the only showroom open at 2am.
intro.body: It’s where your buyer goes after the reel and before the visit. We build it to tell the same story as everything else, then connect it to your sales team so no lead goes cold.

items.title: Websites
items.body: Brand and business sites that look like the brand and load like a utility.

items.title: Landing pages
items.body: One page, one job. For launches, campaigns and offers.

items.title: Scroll-animated and 3D sites
items.body: Semi-immersive sites where the story moves as you scroll. For launches that deserve an entrance.

items.title: Walkthroughs
items.body: Virtual walkthroughs of finished spaces, and of spaces not yet built, marked as artist’s impressions.

items.title: Custom apps
items.body: Tools your team or your customers will actually use: catalogues, configurators, booking flows.

items.title: CRM and workflow automation
items.body: Leads captured, routed, followed up and tracked. Your site, WhatsApp, email and sales team, connected.

backend.headline: The story doesn’t end at the enquiry form.
backend.body: Plenty of beautiful websites leak leads. We connect the form to the follow-up: who gets the lead, how fast, what they send, what happens next. Story at the front, system at the back.

mobile.headline: Built for the phone in your buyer’s hand.
mobile.body: Most of your buyers will see the site on a mid-range phone, on mobile data. We design immersive work to load fast there first, and impress on a big screen second.

items.body: E-commerce and brand sites, catalogue tools, WhatsApp enquiry flows, store-visit booking.
Project sites, EOI and launch landing pages, walkthroughs, CRM workflows for sales teams and channel partners.
Portfolio sites that look as considered as the work, and enquiry flows that qualify leads.
Corporate and product portfolio sites, careers pages, training portals.

items.q: Which platforms do you build on?
items.a: Whatever suits the job and the team who’ll run it. We recommend a platform in the proposal. [VERIFY: platforms you support]

items.q: Can you connect our website to our CRM?
items.a: Yes. We set up lead capture, routing and follow-ups in the CRM you use, or help you choose one. [VERIFY: CRMs you support]

items.q: Will a 3D site be slow?
items.a: Not if it’s built properly. We design for a mid-range phone on mobile data first, because that’s how most buyers will see it.
